# rexdiff does not start when its input is wrong, and says what is wrong.
! exec rexdiff $WORK
stderr '^rexdiff: open .+: git rev-parse: fatal: not a git repository'
exec git init -q repo
! exec rexdiff repo -wrap=false
stderr '^unknown argument "-wrap=false" \(flags go before the repo\)$'
stderr '^usage: rexdiff'
! exec rexdiff -nope
stderr -count=1 'flag provided but not defined: -nope'

# A -log FIFO with no reader is an error at once, not a wait for a reader.
exec mkfifo fifo
! exec rexdiff -log fifo repo
stderr '^rexdiff: open log fifo: the FIFO has no reader, start one first$'

# -check checks the settings without a repository, for the Rex action.
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"layuot": "split"}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "layuot"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"layout": "sideways"}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for layout: expected one of unified, split, not "sideways"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"next-file": ["x"], "prev-file": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "x" is bound to both "next-file" and "prev-file"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"url_opener": "{url} --new"}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for url_opener: expected a command that names a program first, not "{url} --new"$'

# As in herdr-reviewr, the settings take the old names of three actions.
exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"list-wider": ["W"], "preview": ["M"]}}'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"rendered": ["M"], "preview": ["P"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "rendered" and "preview" name the same action$'

# The names of the settings and of the actions are those of herdr-reviewr.
exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"next-hunk": ["x"], "send": ["S"], "navigator-hide": ["Z"], "keys": ["H"]}, "file_list": "left", "file_list_width": 40, "url_opener": "open {url}"}'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"file_list_width": 3}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for file_list_width: expected 16 or more, not "3"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"down": ["bogus"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings.down: expected a list of keys'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"down": ["x"], "up": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "x" is bound to both "down" and "up"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"down": ["x", "x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "x" is bound twice to "down"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"down": ["U"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "U" is bound to both "down" and "update"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"next-hunk": ["j"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: invalid value for keybindings: "j" is bound to both "down" and "next-hunk"$'

# Other names of the settings and of the actions are unknown keys.
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"list_position": "left"}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "list_position"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"list_width": 40}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "list_width"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"browser": "open {url}"}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "browser"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"move-down": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "keybindings.move-down"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"next-change": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "keybindings.next-change"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"toggle-split": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "keybindings.toggle-split"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"toggle-help": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "keybindings.toggle-help"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -config '{"keybindings": {"upgrade": ["x"]}}'
stderr '^rexdiff: config: unknown key "keybindings.upgrade"$'

# A bad value of a flag names the flag, as the settings do.
! exec rexdiff -layout sideways repo
stderr '^rexdiff: invalid value for -layout: expected one of unified, split, not "sideways"$'
! exec rexdiff -scope all repo
stderr '^rexdiff: invalid value for -scope: expected one of uncommitted, branch, last-turn, not "all"$'
! exec rexdiff -wrap no repo
stderr '^rexdiff: invalid value for -wrap: expected one of on, off, not "no"$'

# -check checks the flags as a normal start does.
! exec rexdiff -check -layout sideways
stderr '^rexdiff: invalid value for -layout: expected one of unified, split, not "sideways"$'
! exec rexdiff -check -scope all
stderr '^rexdiff: invalid value for -scope: expected one of uncommitted, branch, last-turn, not "all"$'
exec rexdiff -check -layout split -scope branch
